evidence: The two coordination-orchestrator.js files have different Git blob SHAs.
The integrated copy adds preliminaryOnly, legacyStatusOnly, assumptions and statusScope safeguards.
The integrated package declares @mizan/engineering-core@1.0.0 and includes p1-ir.test.js in its test command.
mizan-review-v1.js binds review results to candidateId/geometryHash and explicitly marks unsupported engineering disciplines NOT_EVALUATED.
dist/gemini-engineering-layer.mjs consumes the separate UI copy for preliminary display review.
policy: The integrated Engineering Core + MIZAN-IR review adapter is authoritative for candidate acceptance/rejection in the integrated pipeline.
The dist/gemini Engineering Core remains a legacy UI preliminary-review copy only; it is not authoritative for integrated candidate acceptance.
This formal split does not assert byte identity between the copies.
Any future consolidation requires a post-baseline change with tests and provenance evidence.
